editorial:
Imagine living in a world where your entire worth is based on how many people are watching you live your life on a screen. That is exactly what you get here. You follow a group of people who are obsessed with fame and will do almost anything to get more viewers. The vibe is tense and a bit creepy because it feels like a warning about how we use social media today. It starts off as a drama but quickly turns into a wild ride as the characters push boundaries just to stay relevant in the eyes of the public.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing about who is actually in control. The acting feels real, and the action picks up right when you think things are slowing down. While some parts of the plot might feel a bit rushed, the overall idea is super interesting. If you love stories about fame gone wrong, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the characters realize that their audience is actually controlling their movements and choices. In the final scenes, the lead discovers that the fame they wanted is actually a trap used to manipulate them. The twist reveals that the viewers are the ones pulling the strings for entertainment. It wraps up with a bleak look at how people will trade their freedom and privacy just to feel liked by strangers online.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Black Mirror style stories and thrillers about fame.
